crew.overview: The true story of the inseparable Von Erich brothers, who made history in the intensely competitive world of professional wrestling in the early 1980s. Through tragedy and triumph, under the shadow of their domineering father and coach, the brothers seek larger-than-life immortality on the biggest stage in sports.
crew.title: The Iron Claw

details.biography: David Michael Ross Adkisson is an American professional wrestler under the ring name Ross Von Erich. He is the son of Kevin Von Erich and the brother of Marshall Von Erich. With Marshall, he debuted in 2012 and currently wrestle together as team Von Erich 3G. Their debut match was in Pro Wrestling NOAH. Accompanied by their father at ringside, Ross and Marshall made their TNA debut match at Slammiversary XII on June 15, 2014.
details.name: Ross Von Erich
